reference_framework: SEBI Fake Trading App Scam Landscape & Social Media Fraud Orders (2023-2026)

stages.description: Initial targeting via algorithmic feeds to attract inexperienced investors.

behaviours.name: Luxury Lifestyle Flexing
behaviours.description: Exhibiting rented supercars, stacks of cash, or luxury watches to manufacture the illusion of effortless market riches.

behaviours.name: Celebrity / Authority Deepfake
behaviours.description: Synthetically manipulated video/audio impersonating prominent corporate leaders or ministers endorsing secret investment pools.

behaviours.name: Zero-Loss Algo Trading Bot
behaviours.description: Marketing proprietary AI or algorithmic bot software promising consistent daily returns with zero drawdowns.

behaviours.name: Institutional / Insider Tip Claim
behaviours.description: Claiming access to confidential institutional block deals, pre-IPO allotments, or insider SEBI tip sheets.

stages.description: Fabricating regulatory compliance to neutralize investor skepticism.

behaviours.name: Forged SEBI Registration Certificate
behaviours.description: Presenting photoshopped SEBI certificates featuring fictitious or stolen RIA/RA registration numbers.

behaviours.name: Broker Brand Impersonation
behaviours.description: Operating under lookalike names, logos, and typography mimicking reputed brokers like Zerodha, Groww, ICICI Direct, or Tata Capital.

behaviours.name: Deceptive Literacy Masterclass
behaviours.description: Framing paid stock tipping operations as a 'Free Investor Awareness Webinar' or educational charity drive.

behaviours.name: Coordinated Social Shill Reviews
behaviours.description: Coordinated bot networks posting identical testimonial screenshots of multi-lakh bank credits in chat channels.

stages.description: Manipulating investor psychology through irrational exuberance and artificial urgency.

behaviours.name: Guaranteed / Assured Return Promise
behaviours.description: Promising fixed percentage returns (e.g., 200% monthly, 5% daily), in direct violation of SEBI PFUTP Regulations.

behaviours.name: Artificial Scarcity & Countdown
behaviours.description: Pressuring targets with claims that 'VIP registration closes in 2 hours' or 'Only 3 institutional seats remaining'.

behaviours.name: Zero Capital Risk / 100% Protection
behaviours.description: False assertions that capital is 100% insured against downside market volatility.

stages.description: Bypassing regulated digital app stores and official exchange clearing pipelines.

behaviours.name: Direct Sideloaded APK Link
behaviours.description: Directing victims to install Android APK files via Telegram/WhatsApp or obscure download domains not audited by Google Play Protect.

behaviours.name: Personal UPI Handle Payment Request
behaviours.description: Demanding deposit of trading capital to individual UPI handles (@okaxis, @ybl, @paytm) or mule current accounts rather than registered broker escrows.

behaviours.name: Remote Access Software Installation
behaviours.description: Asking victims to install screen-sharing software (AnyDesk, TeamViewer) under the guise of 'KYC assistance'.

stages.description: Generating fictitious paper wealth to prime the victim for larger capital infusion.

behaviours.name: Simulated Portfolio Gains
behaviours.description: Displaying fabricated high-frequency trading balances and charts entirely detached from live NSE/BSE matching engines.

behaviours.name: Absence of Official Exchange Contract Notes
behaviours.description: No Unique Client Code (UCC) registration, no daily exchange SMS alerts, and no CDSL/NSDL transaction statements.

behaviours.name: Micro-Withdrawal Baiting
behaviours.description: Allowing an initial small withdrawal (₹1,000 - ₹3,000) to dissolve victim doubt and elicit multi-lakh deposits.

stages.description: Pressuring victims to exhaust savings or take loans to participate in illusory elite rounds.

behaviours.name: Mandatory Capital Doubling for VIP Tier
behaviours.description: Compelling victim to deposit additional capital to prevent existing trades from being closed or penalized.

behaviours.name: Personal Loan / Asset Liquidation Coercion
behaviours.description: Advising investors to break fixed deposits, liquidate mutual funds, or take instant personal loans to maximize profits.

stages.description: Blocking fund repatriation and demanding fraudulent fees under regulatory disguises.

behaviours.name: Advance Capital Gains Tax Extortion
behaviours.description: Demanding that 20%-30% tax be paid in advance via UPI before withdrawals can be processed, which is contrary to Indian tax deduction laws.

behaviours.name: Bogus SEBI / RBI Clearance Fee
behaviours.description: Fabricating notices stating SEBI or RBI has frozen the funds until an administrative fee or anti-money-laundering bond is paid.

behaviours.name: Legal Prosecution & Blackmail Threat
behaviours.description: Threatening victim with police cyber arrest, tax audit raids, or credit score destruction if balance is not paid immediately.

stages.description: Covering tracks, purging community channels, and deploying secondary recovery scams.

behaviours.name: Victim Ejection & Channel Purge
behaviours.description: Banning questioning members from the group, deleting chat histories, and wiping admin profiles.

behaviours.name: Dynamic Alias & Handle Migration
behaviours.description: Renaming group handles, re-registering fresh domain landing pages, and switching to backup UPI VPIs.

behaviours.name: Secondary Cyber Recovery Impersonation
behaviours.description: Approaching defrauded victims disguised as SEBI ombudsmen, legal advocates, or ethical hackers claiming to recover lost money for an advance fee.
